verdict.rationale: BILL supports custom approval policies, vendor autopay triggers, and webhook event subscriptions that notify external systems on events (e.g., bill created, vendor autopay), which enable rule-like automation, but this is largely policy-based (approvals, autopay) rather than a general user-defined 'if event then action' rules engine natively in the product; true automation requires building via API/webhooks rather than a no-code rules UI. missing for 10: a native no-code rule builder for arbitrary trigger-action automation, evidence of end-to-end automation without custom development, and independent confirmation of this workflow in practice.
